name: Granael
source:
Granael (グラナエル, Guranaeru) is a high-ranking angel in the third part of Monster Girl Quest!.

She appears accompanying Chamael, Runael and Veteran Angel Soldiers in Sealed Sinner’s Prison, ambushing Luka and Alice. [spoiler]However Alice’s interference with the prison inadvertently releases Heinrich’s soul, who swiftly defeats Granael’s companions using Luka’s body before using Element Spica on her, much to her and the angels’ shock. [/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Granael]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
